title: 5 CD Lot Jazz: Spyro Gyra, Bob James, Hiroshima, Twist of Jobim, Charlie Brown
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Discs and jewel cases show normal light wear consistent with age/storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Lot of 5 pre-owned contemporary jazz CDs. Includes:

Spyro Gyra - Breakout (MCA, 1986)
Bob James - Obsession (Warner Bros., 1986)
Hiroshima - Go (Epic, 1987)
A Twist of Jobim - Various Artists (i.e. music/Polygram, 1997), produced by Lee Ritenour, featuring Oleta Adams, El DeBarge, Dave Grusin, Herbie Hancock, Al Jarreau and The Yellowjackets
Happy Anniversary, Charlie Brown! (GRP, 1989), featuring Patti Austin, David Benoit, Dave Brubeck, Chick Corea, Kenny G, Dave Grusin, B.B. King, Gerry Mulligan, Lee Ritenour and Joe Williams

All 5 CDs, jewel cases, and pictured inserts/artwork are included. Items are pre-owned and may show normal cosmetic wear from age and storage. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents.

You will receive the exact CDs pictured.
